dataset_label: pilot set; hand-written question stems and source spans checked; 4 planned-term validator failures retained; not yet human-reviewed
metrics: page-level Recall@1/3/5 and MRR; failed query = 0; not-run infrastructure exclusions omitted

pageindex.index_build_time_definition: Wall-clock around local SDK submit_document and retrieval-readiness verification; null when a verified cached tree is reused.
pageindex.query_latency_definition: Wall-clock for the PageIndex agent run plus citation extraction.
pageindex.cache_reuse_validation: Completed manifest entry, exact extracted PDF page text, valid node page ranges, and a retrieval-ready SDK get_tree response.
pageindex.ranking_derivation: Successful get_page_content tool results, in tool-call order; within each call, use the returned_pages order; deduplicate by first occurrence. Outline-only calls are not ranked.
pageindex.token_usage_source: PageIndex SDK stream's raw OpenAI-compatible response usage; null when the provider does not return counts.
